nodes.description: string public name; token name 'Delive' set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol 'DVE' set in constructor
uint8 public decimals; set to 5 in constructor
uint256 public _totalSupply; total token supply set to 6000000000000 in constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances; internal ledger of token ownership
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger
constructor(); initializes name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and mints entire supply to msg.sender
totalSupply() view; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unguarded subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view; returns balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view; returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint tokens); writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address to, uint tokens); debits caller via safeSub and credits recipient via safeAdd
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens); debits from, reduces allowance of msg.sender and credits to
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; computes a + b with require(c >= a)
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; computes a - b with require(b <= a)
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; computes a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; computes a / b with require(b > 0)
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom
Unguarded subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() (arithmetic underflow risk)
Addition a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a)
Subtraction a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a)
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
Division a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0)
